source_gate: Real Submitted plus independently passing all frozen public checks and source-target leakage guard; no manual source solution or narrative.
knowledge_treatment: Verified source delivery record in a fresh per-target database; empty controls have identical tools and empty fresh databases. No target-generated result is reused.
analysis: Keep all planned rows and failures. Compare retrieval-empty with retrieval-verified at equal task/profile/budget; report paired observed differences without claiming statistical significance. Baseline contrasts change context policy. Separately record source costs. Unstarted rows stay unknown.
limits: Remote alias weights and sampling seed cannot be pinned
Two repetitions are not independent seeded samples
Small fixed public development tasks, not full SWE-bench
No physical multi-machine or billion-user claim
